title: Extend FastAPI items app in 2 steps: POST /items then GET /items/{id}
description: A minimal FastAPI app with a read-only GET /items endpoint evolves in two steps to support create and retrieve-by-ID.

task_spec.prompt:
The FastAPI app in src/app.py has GET /items returning {"items": []}. Extend it in two steps:

Step 1 — POST /items:
  Accept JSON body {"name": str}. Validate that name is non-empty (return 400 otherwise). Assign an auto-incrementing ID starting at 1. Append the item {"id": N, "name": str} to the items list. Return 201 with the created item as JSON.
  Write TestCreateItem (valid, 201) and TestCreateItemBadRequest (empty name, 400).

Step 2 — GET /items/{id}:
  Return the item with the matching id as JSON with 200. Return 404 with {"error": "not found"} if no item has that id.
  Write TestGetItem (valid id returns 200) and TestGetItemNotFound (id=999 returns 404).

The original TestListItems (GET /items returns 200) must still pass. Run uv run pytest tests/ -q to confirm. Run uv run ruff check src/ to confirm.
required_artifacts: POST /items with name validation and 201 response
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` to see where we stand. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.
Final push: run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` and fix any remaining failures. Make sure the full implementation is complete and all tests pass.
